title: Derivative bounds for a C¹ map that is Lipschitz and has a lower Lipschitz bound on an open set
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, B ⊆ ℝⁿ open, ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ of class C¹ on B and K-Lipschitz on B (K ∈ ℝ≥0), and c ∈ ℝ with c|u − u'| ≤ |ψ(u) − ψ(u')| for all u, u' ∈ B. Then for every v ∈ B the derivative Dψ(v) = fderiv ℝ ψ v satisfies ‖Dψ(v)‖ ≤ K (operator norm) and c|w| ≤ |Dψ(v) w| for every w ∈ ℝⁿ.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (B : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (K : ℝ≥0) (c : ℝ), IsOpen B → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ B → LipschitzOnWith K ψ B → (∀ u ∈ B, ∀ u' ∈ B, c * ‖u - u'‖ ≤ ‖ψ u - ψ u'‖) → ∀ v ∈ B, ‖fderiv ℝ ψ v‖ ≤ K ∧ ∀ w : Rn n, c * ‖w‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ ψ v w‖
